name: ng-postcode
description: Validate, look up and resolve addresses to Nigeria's NIPOST digital postcodes (NDAPS).
long_description: Tools for Nigeria's 11-character building postcode, such as EK-01-A03-FK-01. Validation runs offline and needs no key. Lookup, autocomplete, reverse geocoding and address resolution call the postcode.gov.ng API with your own NIPOST key.

tools.name: validate_postcode
tools.description: Check a postcode's structure offline and return its canonical forms and segments.

tools.name: lookup_postcode
tools.description: Confirm a postcode is assigned to a building. Free.

tools.name: lookup_postcode_details
tools.description: Return a postcode's address and building details. Every call consumes NIPOST credits.

tools.name: autocomplete_postcode
tools.description: Suggest completions for the next segment of a partly typed postcode.

tools.name: find_postcode_at_location
tools.description: Return the postcode of the nearest building to a coordinate in Nigeria.

tools.name: resolve_address
tools.description: Turn a described Nigerian address into a postcode, only as precisely as the evidence allows.

api_key.title: NIPOST API key
api_key.description: A key from dashboard.postcode.gov.ng. Validation works without one.

max_level.title: Highest lookup level
max_level.description: 1 to 5. Levels 2 and up consume NIPOST credits.
